Switching to rand1 with higher mutation and exploration increases diversity and novelty-driven sampling, while auto surrogate handles the small-sample model choice via held-out RMSE. Lower local_fraction and wider radius reduce premature convergence before more data accumulates; population 30 with 8 generations balances surrogate-guided candidate generation against the remaining fixed budget.

Population 28 with 6 generations fits the remaining fixed budget.
